speaker: agnes_tipping
text: That's a jackdaw on my sign, Master Shakespeare, not a crow. A crow would never give credit. Dinner is sixpence, and the settle is free.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Ale, Agnes, and the sixpence. We have been at it all afternoon, and I am thirsty.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Six-and-thirty on the share. Say it once, and then let it be. The Rose had a second Hercules new yesterday. I am gloomy about giants.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You may be gloomy, John. I went to the first of them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They've a god in a lion's skin. You shall have a looking-glass.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A what?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He's given up the crown. He sends for a glass to see what a face looks like that's no king. He looks. Then he breaks it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give it me. When?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When I've written how he gets there.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: How he gets there is your work. The breaking is mine. You will not give the break to a property man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The break is yours. I am not buying a glass tonight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A glass is four shillings, and he'll break one every time.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Four shillings is a good many dinners. Break mine and I will know the hand.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Not your glasses, Agnes. A glass in a play. What is he doing while he looks?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He looks. That is the doing. Then the break. He is not in that room yet. Tonight he is only down.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The second Hercules was yesterday, and I did not go, and I am still gloomy. I am not naming their sum. I have not got it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Theirs was not wasted. I am not pricing it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Kemp's interest, six days: nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nineteen. He was not in the book I played today.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The nineteen are not today's. Six days. The goose is the noise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six days, nineteen lines. He has not seen this book. I am not showing it here.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the tally stays with you, Abel. Four shillings is a fact. A broken glass every time is the warning. I have said both.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: When the way to it is written, you send for me. I will not hear the break from a margin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will send when he is there. Tonight he is only down.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Down is a fine place for a king who is paying sixpence. My settle is for sitting. Take the rest of it home.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sixpence, then. You have a small cruel thing, Will, and I am glad of the size of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Glad is too large. It is a glass against a giant. That is the size of it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The size of it is four shillings, until it is broken, and then it is four shillings again.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I am going before someone asks me to read the nineteen aloud. They are not improved by reading.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Pay the sixpence before you improve anything. The slate knows the house. He is not here to spill, which is a mercy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is not here. Good. Sixpence, four shillings, nineteen lines. I am for home, and for the page.
